items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Fat Man, he was - he had been a bass player with what, Fat Faller? I forget his real name, but he had a place in Harlem on 155th Street.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

used to be quite a few clubs around Boston Road. And there was a club up here that was a branch of the Fat Man on Sugar Hill where the musicians used to hang out at after hours. And of course, Fat Man, he was - he had been a bass player with what, Fat Faller? I forget his real name, but he had a place in Harlem on 155th Street. And of course I bought this house from Eddie Mallory who was married to Ethel Waters at one time. And Eddie Mallory was running the Bronx Branch of Fat Man.
You mentioned the name George Duvivier one time.
